data.name: CRAST
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO CRAST

CRAST is a multiplayer first-person shooter that combines intense combat, urban exploration, valuable loot, and weapon progression.

Every match is a choice between risk and reward. Explore the map, gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and find your own path to victory.

EXPLORE THE CITY

Venture into an urban district inspired by the right bank of Astana.

Enter open buildings, explore streets and rooftops, and search for weapons, resources, and valuable loot. Every expedition can lead to both great rewards and unexpected dangers.

COLLECT LOOT

Gather Gold, Silver, and Bronze during matches.

Earn crafting materials of different rarities and use them to improve your equipment between games.

CRAFT ATTACHMENTS

Enhance your weapons through the crafting system.

Create Green, Blue, and Purple attachments, improve weapon performance, and build loadouts suited to different combat situations.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARSENAL

Adapt your weapons to match your playstyle.

Experiment with different builds, improve your equipment's effectiveness, and prepare for the challenges ahead.

BEWARE OF DANGERS

Other players are not the only threat.

Zombies roam the city and can interfere with your plans at the worst possible moment. Meanwhile, the safe zone continues to shrink, forcing players into increasingly dangerous encounters.

EXTRACT OR FIGHT TO THE END

Leave the battlefield through an extraction point or risk everything for victory.

Only the most skilled players will survive the final moments of the match and become the last player standing.

GAME FEATURES

• Battle Royale gameplay with extraction mechanics.
• Urban exploration with open buildings and rooftops.
• Weapon, resource, and loot scavenging.
• Crafting system with attachment progression.
• Green, Blue, and Purple rarity attachments.
• Deep weapon customization.
• Zombies as an additional threat across the map.
• Dynamic day and night cycle.
• Persistent arsenal progression between matches.

Gather resources, improve your weapons, and prove that you have what it takes to survive in the world of CRAST.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
